I have been farming this rice plot for many years, so I know it needs fertilizer to give a good harvest. I will try to buy two bags of the subsidized NPK from the government agent if he comes to our village, and I will also spread cow manure that we collected during the dry season. I will plant the rice seed I saved from last year because the new seeds from the agro-dealer are too expensive, and my children and I will do most of the weeding and harvesting by hand. When the harvest is ready, I will hire some young people from the village for a short time because we must cut the rice quickly before the rain damages it.
